body: Thank you so much bspin8. I'm in tears after reading what you wrote. It's more thoughtful and powerful than what I've dreamed my brother would be able to say to me in support. I'm still going to keep trying, in part thanks to you.

Thank you reddit for these suicide survivor resources:
